question: A flight procedures trainer simulates instrument responses, simple control functions and the performance and flight characteristics of aircraft of:

options.text: A particular type
A particular type and series, including a visual system and motion
Any category
A particular class

explanation: A flight procedures trainer provides a realistic flight deck environment and simulates aircraft of a particular class. A flight simulator represents a particular type.

question: A basic instrument flight trainer is a device that:

options.text: Is used only to teach radio telephony procedures and is not counted for instrument time at all
Has a full motion system and visual display
Is equipped with appropriate instruments and simulates the flight deck in instrument flight conditions
Represents the flight deck of a particular aircraft type

explanation: A basic instrument flight trainer is equipped with appropriate instruments and simulates the flight deck environment in instrument flight conditions.

question: A Contracting State is any State that is party to the Convention on International Civil Aviation signed at Chicago on:

options.text: 13 October 1919
7 December 1944
4 April 1947
7 December 1945

explanation: The Chicago Convention was signed on 7 December 1944. It came into force in April 1947, which is the date sometimes confused with it.

question: The State of Design is the State having jurisdiction over:

options.text: The register on which the aircraft is entered
The operator of the aircraft
The organization responsible for the type design
The organization responsible for final assembly

explanation: The State of Design has jurisdiction over the organization responsible for the type design. The State of Manufacture is responsible for final assembly.

question: The State of Registry is:

options.text: The State on whose register the aircraft is entered
The State whose territory the aircraft is flying over
The State where the operator has its principal place of business
The State where the aircraft was manufactured

explanation: The State of Registry is simply the State on whose register the aircraft is entered.

question: The competent authority is the authority responsible, under the law of the State, for:

options.text: Collecting airport charges and navigation fees
Providing air traffic services
Investigating accidents
Promoting the safety of civil aviation

explanation: The competent authority is the authority responsible under the State's law for promoting the safety of civil aviation.

question: For the purposes of the definitions, cargo includes:

options.text: Fuel carried in excess of the flight's requirement
Passengers' checked baggage
Mail and animals
Aircraft stores and spare parts

explanation: Cargo includes mail and animals.

question: Which manoeuvre is listed among aerobatic manoeuvres?

options.text: A steep turn at 45° of bank
A stall turn
A sideslip on final approach
A rate one turn

explanation: Aerobatic manoeuvres include loops, spins, rolls, bunts, stall turns, inverted flying and similar manoeuvres. Steep turns and sideslips are normal flight manoeuvres.

question: A captive flight is a flight by an uncontrollable balloon during which it is:

options.text: Attached to the surface by a restraining device
Free of any attachment to the surface
Towed by an aircraft or vehicle at low level
Controlled in height by its commander

explanation: In captive flight the balloon is attached to the surface by a restraining device. A free balloon is not attached to the surface.

question: The commander of an aircraft is the member of the flight crew:

options.text: Holding the highest licence on board
Handling the controls during the take-off and the landing at the destination aerodrome
With the most hours on the type
Designated as commander by the operator, or failing that the pilot-in-command

explanation: The commander is the flight crew member designated by the operator; failing such a person, it is the person who is for the time being the PIC.
